outputs.shell: Participants; events; censored; median in months (95% CI); hazard ratio (95% CI); log-rank p-value.

display.title: Table 14.2.1 Progression-free survival by independent review (primary endpoint)
head: ONK-44 400 mg
Docetaxel

rows.label: Hazard ratio, ONK-44 vs docetaxel (95% CI)

footnotes: Progression by RECIST 1.1 as read by the blinded independent central review, or death from any cause. Censored at the last adequate tumour assessment.
Kaplan-Meier medians; 95% CI by the Brookmeyer-Crowley method with log(-log) limits. NE: not estimable. Cox proportional hazards model with treatment (Breslow ties); unstratified log-rank test.

outputs.title: Table 14.2.2: progression-free survival by the investigator (sensitivity analysis)
outputs.shell: Participants; events; censored; median in months (95% CI); hazard ratio (95% CI); log-rank p-value.

head: ONK-44 400 mg
Docetaxel

rows.label: Hazard ratio, ONK-44 vs docetaxel (95% CI)

footnotes: Progression by RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the investigator, or death. Censored at the last adequate assessment.
Kaplan-Meier medians; 95% CI by the Brookmeyer-Crowley method with log(-log) limits. NE: not estimable. Cox proportional hazards model with treatment (Breslow ties); unstratified log-rank test.

outputs.title: Table 14.2.3: best overall response (RECIST 1.1)
outputs.shell: Best overall response by independent review, then by the investigator; objective response rate with exact 95% CI; difference with 95% CI; agreement between the two reviews.

display.title: Table 14.2.3 Best overall response
head: ONK-44 400 mg
Docetaxel
footnotes: Independent review and investigator agreed on whether a participant responded for 41 of 42 participants (97.6%).

Best overall response from the RECIST 1.1 overall responses up to progression; stable disease counts only if assessed at least 5 weeks after randomisation; responses need no confirmation in this randomised study. 95% CI for each rate by the Clopper-Pearson method; for the difference, a Wald interval.

outputs.shell: Participants; events; censored; median in months (95% CI); hazard ratio (95% CI); log-rank p-value.

rows.label: Hazard ratio, ONK-44 vs docetaxel (95% CI)

footnotes: Death from any cause; censored at the last date known alive, no later than the data cut-off (2026-10-31). The analysis is not final: few deaths had occurred at the cut-off.
Kaplan-Meier medians; 95% CI by the Brookmeyer-Crowley method with log(-log) limits. NE: not estimable. Cox proportional hazards model with treatment (Breslow ties); unstratified log-rank test.
